FAQs
Ask Away. We’ve Heard It All.

What colors are in Arctic Smoke stone panels?

Arctic Smoke features a soft white base with light gray and carbon-colored highlights. The combination creates a clean, modern stone appearance with natural depth and variation.

What style of home works best with Arctic Smoke?

Arctic Smoke is especially popular on modern homes, contemporary exteriors, farmhouse-style designs, interior accent walls, and foundation and entryway upgrades. Its bright, neutral palette complements a wide variety of architectural styles.

Is Arctic Smoke a warm or cool color?

Arctic Smoke leans cool with its soft white and gray foundation, while subtle carbon highlights add contrast and depth. The result is a balanced color profile that feels both modern and inviting.

Does Arctic Smoke make a space feel brighter?

Yes. The lighter color palette reflects more light than darker stone profiles, helping create an open, airy appearance both indoors and outdoors.

Is Arctic Smoke easy to install?

Yes. Customers consistently mention how easy Arctic Smoke panels are to cut, install, and work with using common tools. Installation videos, guides, and project coordinator support help make the process straightforward.

What do customers like most about Arctic Smoke?

Customers frequently mention bright modern appearance, realistic stone texture, easy installation, and exceptional customer support. Many also praise the finished look and versatility across different project types.

Can Arctic Smoke be used indoors and outdoors?

Yes. Arctic Smoke works beautifully for fireplaces, accent walls, exterior facades, foundations, entryways, and many other residential or commercial applications.
